title: Former army psychic who spied on Mars claims he spotted 12ft-tall humans - Space News - News
excerpt: A former U.S. Army psychic claims his remote viewing of Mars showed giant humans, roads and ruined structures. His account is not a verified discovery.
content:
Joe McMoneagle claims he was paid to map Mars using his mind (Image: @AlignPodcast/YouTube)

A former US Army psychic who says he was compensated by military leadership to chart the universe using mental abilities claims he observed 12ft-tall giants and damaged infrastructure on Mars.

Joe McMoneagle was recruited for Project Stargate, an unusual Cold War program initiated in 1977 to determine whether human mental capacity could be utilized for military intelligence gathering.

The classified operation continued for 18 years before being discontinued in 1995. The extraordinary project even served as inspiration for Jon Ronson's bestselling book and film The Men Who Stare at Goats, featuring George Clooney.

"Some [out of body experiences] are objective observations and some are subjective experiences," he explained. "You've got to be careful of the subjective experiences, because like I said every human being is in their own world."

The military psychic made a startling revelation when he stated he was assigned to employ his skills to monitor the Red Planet (Image: Getty Images/iStockphoto)

The military psychic made a startling revelation when he stated he was assigned to employ his skills to monitor the Red Planet, reports the Daily Star.

McMoneagle explained: "I got targeted on Mars. It made me very angry because if I can't prove what I've targeted to some extent at a later date or whenever...then I get upset because I'm not learning better things about remote viewing."

Committed to demonstrating he wasn't simply experiencing visions, he says he brought his mentally-gathered coordinates to space specialists on Earth. He stated: "When that happened I kept all the material. I went to Jet Propulsion Laboratory on the West Coast and I got a packet.

The classified operation continued for 18 years before being discontinued in 1995 (Image: undefined)

"When I gave him the GPS locations, he said 'oh, that's the old city of Mars'. He actually opened the drawer and gave me all the four by four negatives for those areas that I had targeted."

After examining the satellite imagery, McMoneagle maintains he discovered unmistakable evidence of an ancient extraterrestrial civilization constructed on the red planet's dusty terrain.

"They show foundations of buildings, machines that are broken down and partially destroyed, paths, roads, mines," he stated, even asserting he identified an enormous "shipping container" resting on the Martian landscape.

Most startling of all, the former military psychic contends that humanity isn't actually indigenous to Earth, proposing we are descendants of giant alien survivors who escaped a Martian catastrophe millions of years ago.

"My perception is everything that I remote viewed on Mars had humans involved," he stated. "They're just like us only twice our size, you can account for that over gravity.

"I'm making a long hairy guess that's probably us and something happened on Mars that was eradicating us as an entity, and we were brought here deliberately to save us."
